channel: Hinds D1: 3-message follow-up (opened launch page, never registered)
hypothesis: Students who opened the Hinds launch page and never registered have already found Athena, so we expect most won't return. If three short messages that explain what Athena does for them (reads your courses, tells you what to study, coaches you to the answer) bring in even 3 more out of every 100 than a left-out group, register and covered by Hinds within 14 days, it's worth making the standard follow-up.

updates.note: Planned. Steps, copy and buttons: http://localhost:3000/hinds-oct-signups/hinds-drip-experiments.html#d1 (source: work-in-progress/hinds-oct-signups/hinds-drip-experiments.html). Parent project: Hinds October Signups. 3 messages, day 0 / 3 / 7 (proposed Oct 13 / 16 / 20), 1 in 5 left out, read Oct 27. Main metric: registered and covered by Hinds within 14 days vs. left-out group; target 3 more out of every 100 (a guess). Blocked on: a way to reach people with no email on file, legal/privacy sign-off, and product confirming 'free'. Copy not yet through messaging-review.

channel: Hinds D2: 3-message follow-up (registered, haven't come back)
hypothesis: About 215 Hinds students registered but aren't using Athena. If three short plain-text messages show them one next step and ask what would make Athena worth opening, 10 more out of every 100 will start using it within 10 days than a left-out group.

updates.note: Planned. Steps, copy and buttons: http://localhost:3000/hinds-oct-signups/hinds-drip-experiments.html#d2 (source: work-in-progress/hinds-oct-signups/hinds-drip-experiments.html).
